_definitions.total_documents: Count of active documents that have at least one ruling record (JOIN documents d ... JOIN rulings r ON r.document_id = d.id) within the field completeness check window. This is the denominator for all field completeness percentages. It does NOT include orphaned documents (those with no ruling).
